02 / A FAMILY, A KITCHEN, A CENTURY

The recipes
came with us.

It began in Sheikhupura in 1916. During Partition, the family made Amritsar home—and carried their recipes with them.

Generations later, we’re still cooking, serving, and making room at the table.
